name: 盲图像质量评估 (BRISQUE)
description: 使用 natural scene statistics to evaluate image quality and detect distortions 表明 AI generation or 篡改.
mechanism: Computes locally normalized luminance 系数 and fits them to a generalized Gaussian 分布. The shape and 方差 parameters are used as 特征 以检测 deviations from natural image statistics.
parameters: Patch size: 7×7, MSCN 系数, GGD fitting, Features: 36-dimensional, SVR model
source: Mittal, A. et al. (2012) — No-Reference Image Quality Assessment in the Spatial Domain, IEEE TIP
useCase: Evaluating naturalness of images to flag AI生成的 or heavily processed content

references.title: Mittal, A. et al. (2012) — No-Reference Image Quality Assessment in the Spatial Domain, IEEE TIP

strengths:
• 不需要参考图像
• Fast computation
• Correlates well with human perception
• 检测 multiple distortion types
limitations:
• May not detect high-quality AI images
• Sensitive to legitimate processing
• Requires calibration per domain
• Not specific to any 伪造 type
